question: Which government scheme aims to provide financial assistance to women Self-Help Groups (SHGs)?

options.text: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 
• **Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)** was launched by the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India, in **June 2011**. 
• The scheme aims to reduce rural poverty by enabling poor households to access gainful self-employment and skilled wage employment opportunities. 
• It focuses on building strong institutional platforms for the rural poor, particularly **women Self-Help Groups (SHGs)**, to enable them to achieve sustainable livelihoods. 
• The program provides **financial assistance** and capacity building to women SHGs, helping them start micro-enterprises and other income-generating activities.
